violated_contract: The omi console and python -m omi_cli entrypoints must preserve literal user/API text in human output and provide parseable JSON results, structured diagnostics, and documented exit codes in JSON mode. Per-command printing, markup escaping, implicit prompts, and entrypoint-specific error handling must not bypass this public contract.
canonical_prevention: Renderer owns literal data, status, diagnostic, completion, and confirmation output. Both entrypoints call main(), which selects the renderer before strict parsing and normalizes parser, API, transport, interruption, and unexpected failures. A reusable conformance fixture invokes the actual console target and module entrypoint across both modes, including newly registered commands, empty results, configuration mutations, local tools, and failure paths.
